title: Grateful Dead Live at Indianapolis State Fair Coliseum on 1973-10-27
lineage: MSR > R > C > D > CD  patched with MAC > ? > D

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording that clears up after the first few tunes, delivering a smoking Truckin' and incendiary China‑Rider jam with Keith’s keys on fire.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture starts a bit muddied but quickly sharpens into clear, bright sound for the bulk of this legendary ’73 show.  Highlights include an earth‑shaking Truckin', a blistering China > Rider sequence and a seamless Big River → Playin' reprise, all powered by Jerry’s scorching guitar and Keith’s unstoppable keyboards.  A few drop‑outs toward the end and occasional source switches keep it from being perfect, but the performance is overwhelmingly strong.

ai_rating.rationale: 20 detailed reviews are uniformly enthusiastic about the music; recording issues are noted but do not dominate, yielding a high combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Starts muddled for the first tune(s) then becomes clear and bright.  Generally solid board with crisp mids, but occasional drop‑outs near the end and a source change (SBD→AUD) that some listeners found jarring.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down The Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: The band warms up quickly, building energy through a powerful second set; transitions like Playin' → ½ Step → Big River → Playin' are praised for their seamless flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for extra chops, smoky tone and “whipping out” impressive solos.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboard work is highlighted as relentless and melodic—“bangs on the keys like there’s no tomorrow” and delivers a top‑tier solo on Beat It On Down The Line.
